Connor / Jill — quick read: Acme is a clear priority for Q3 given logo and expansion potential. Based on the numbers you sent, I recommend we prepare:

Option A — Short reserved window (6 weeks)
- Commit: equivalent of 120 A100-hrs/day reserved (pilot window)
- Commercial: 20% discount off on-demand per-token rate for the reserved weeks
- Favorable for Acme procurement, easier legal/SLAs.

Option B — Burstable + price cap
- No reserved commit; allow burst up to 200 A100-hrs/day but with a higher nominal per-token rate and a daily cap on spend (e.g., $X/day).
- Faster to enable operationally but riskier for cost predictability.

I'll push the pricing band through with legal; preliminary range: $0.004–$0.006 per token (on-demand), reserved weeks at ~$0.0032–$0.0038 per token depending on commit and term.

Action: Ben will convert Option A into a quick commercial proposal and send a one-pager by EOD Tues.

Operational notes from infra side: we ran a quick availability check and constraints are as follows —

1) Lead time: reallocating reserved slots between deals can be done within 48–72 hours if we can accept transient performance variance. If we need guaranteed tail-latency SLOs for Acme's pilot, lead time stretches to ~7 days to adjust pools and validate routing.

2) Suggested approaches (feasible):
  - Path 1 (Preferred for predictability): carve 60% of the requested pilot capacity as reserved (72 GPU-hrs/day) and leave a 40% burst buffer. This reduces infra churn and still gives some cost benefit to finance/sales.
  - Path 2 (Fastest): allow burst-only with preconfigured auto-fallback to a smaller model variant if demand spikes beyond forecast; requires a promo from product to accept model-quality tradeoffs for the pilot window.

3) Risks: concurrent mid-market pilots could push us over the comfortable burst ceiling in week 2–3; we need a weekly triage cadence during the pilot.

Action items I can take:
- Prepare a short ops runbook for Path 1 and Path 2 + validation checklist (ETA: EOD Wed).
- Lock a temporary pool and run a sizing dry-run (ETA: Thu morning) — need a formal nod from finance on billing guardrails.

Attachment: gpu_capacity_matrix_q3_v2.xlsx (proposed slot mappings & timing)

-Marissa
